description: A fault note beginning exactly at offset 0 is missed by the strpos truthiness bug, so no HTTP call is made (known issue 10). postedTariff therefore stays null, which still passes the alert gate: alerted_at is set and fault_note is not persisted.

phases.label: note begins with GROUND FAULT
sql: UPDATE charge_points SET tariff='PEAK' WHERE id=1

sql.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM revision_details WHERE col='fault_note'
SELECT IFNULL(fault_note,'NULL') FROM charge_points WHERE id=1
SELECT alerted_at FROM charge_points WHERE id=1
